command: env PLATFORM=kvm ARCH=x86 BPFREJIT_CORPUS_APPS=katran BPFREJIT_BENCH_PASSES=map_inline SAMPLES=1 WORKLOAD_DURATION=30 KEEP_WORKDIRS=1 make corpus -o runtime-kernel-image

derived_counts.note: Every derived value is computed from the retained details/loadtime-reports/katran.jsonl stream and the retained per-step bytecode in details/loadtime-workdirs/. The paper's declared Katran 21/62 site figures are not merged with this fresh 16 figure.

log_normalization: Guest-console carriage returns and trailing horizontal whitespace normalized in the retained copy.
scope: Fresh local KVM single-pass map_inline run for Katran only. It retains, for the one changed load instance (balancer_ingress), the per-step input and output bytecode plus the optimizer report, so the rewrite's before/after instruction counts and applied-site totals are derived rather than declared. It exercises the overlay/hint policy path (--inline-hint anchors plus overlays/katran/*.json) that the Cilium row does not. It is a single startup with SAMPLES=1 and does not re-measure the paper's June Katran 21-site/62-site figures, which retained no per-step bytecode; the two are never merged.
